title: Annaye Atyachar
desc: An inebriated Udayan spends a night with his friend's daughter, Kunti, mistaking her to be his wife. He leaves unaware the next morning, setting off a chain of chaotic events.

title: Guru Dakshina
desc: Jayant, an aspiring singer, finds his way to the city in order to make it big. Soon, he garners accolades for his performances and eventually falls in love with the daughter of a ruthless businessman.

title: Projapati
desc: A 65-year-old retired widower, living alone with his son Joy, hopes he will marry to ease his loneliness. However, Joy, a busy wedding planner, has no plans to settle down anytime soon.

title: Boss - Born To Rule
desc: A young man, Surya, aspires to become a gangster. In the process, he ends up falling in love with Rusha, the beloved daughter of a police commissioner.

title: Jeevan Yudh
desc: In order to find his father's killer, Rohit goes back to his hometown. When he meets the new police officer, he unravels a dark truth.
